skills.pageStructureDesc: Generate standard page Anatomy: Wrapper + Content + optional Store, ensuring clear layered page structure.
skills.stateManagementDesc: Create Store based on Zustand slice pattern, including Context Provider and type-safe hooks.
skills.daoLayerDesc: Create data access objects using Drizzle ORM standards, ensuring naming, type safety and query performance.
skills.serviceLayerDesc: Create Service following tRPC + Service + DAO architecture, separating business logic from data access.
skills.formComponentDesc: Create form components following standards, including field validation, state management and UI structure.
skills.schemaValidationDesc: Define database tables using Drizzle ORM schema, ensuring naming, relationships and index configuration standards.
skills.barrelExportDesc: Generate and check index.ts barrel export files, ensuring all index files only do re-export.
skills.errorHandlingDesc: Standardize neverthrow-based error handling, keeping errors explicit and eliminating try-catch from application code.
skills.dbNamingDesc: Verify and correct database table definition naming standards, including table names, column names and indexes.
skills.svgIconDesc: Manage SVG icons in React TypeScript projects, ensuring naming, encapsulation and export standards.
skills.oneComponentDesc: Enforce one React/Vue component per file, no multiple components in one file.
skills.refineTrpcDesc: Access data in React components through Refine hooks via DataProvider, no direct tRPC calls.
